description: This file defines threading classes and thread-local storage management within the Thunder::Core namespace, including the Thread class with thread control methods and a template class for thread-local storage.

classes.name: ThreadLocalStorageType
classes.description: Template class managing thread-local storage for different platforms (Windows and POSIX).

classes.name: Thread
classes.description: Represents a thread with control methods, thread state management, and thread-local storage support.

methods.name: ThreadLocalStorageType::Instance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance managing thread-local storage.

methods.name: ThreadLocalStorageType::Context
methods.description: Accesses the thread-local storage instance for the current thread.

methods.name: ThreadLocalStorageType::IsSet
methods.description: Checks if thread-local storage is set for the current thread.

methods.name: Thread::Thread
methods.description: Constructor initializing thread with optional stack size and name.

methods.name: Thread::Wait
methods.description: Waits for thread state change with timeout.

methods.name: Thread::Yield
methods.description: Yields thread execution with a counter and sleep time.

methods.name: Thread::GetContext
methods.description: Template method to access thread-local storage.

methods.name: Thread::Signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to the thread.

methods.name: Thread::Worker
methods.description: Pure virtual method for thread work execution.
